name: Lumora MCP
purpose: A human and machine-readable design toolkit for selecting web-ready 3D models, owned-original and officially linked web components, multi-style image and UI assets, and externally hosted animated background references.

modelSchema.modelUrl: Relative local path or official remote glTF URL
modelSchema.publicModelUrl: Absolute model URL for Codex and external consumers
modelSchema.files: Optional exact dependency URL map used to resolve streamed Poly Haven glTF packages
modelSchema.agencyUse: Recommended website role for the selected object
modelSchema.brandMoods: Brand moods this object can support
modelSchema.websiteIndustries: Agency verticals where the object is especially useful
modelSchema.sectionFits: Page sections where the object can earn its rendering cost
modelSchema.visualFidelity: Advisory geometry band: very-low-poly, standard-low-poly, or detailed-low-poly
modelSchema.selectionPriority: Advisory shortlist priority; never a hard exclusion rule
modelSchema.selectionGuidance: Art-direction warning or positive guidance to read before selection
modelSchema.bestFor: Visual contexts that fit this asset's actual style
modelSchema.avoidWhen: Visual contexts where the asset is likely to weaken the result
modelSchema.fallbackPolicy: How the asset may still be used when no stronger catalog match exists

modelSelectionGuidance.primaryRule: Do not infer art-direction fit from an object's name or category alone.
modelSelectionGuidance.kenney: Read visualFidelity, selectionPriority, selectionGuidance, avoidWhen, and fallbackPolicy before selecting a Kenney model.
modelSelectionGuidance.fallback: A low-poly Kenney asset remains usable when no closer match exists, but should be adapted deliberately and usually kept secondary unless low-poly styling is intentional.
modelSelectionGuidance.detailedArchitecture: Detailed-low-poly architecture may be shortlisted earlier for stylized spatial work, while still being compared with higher-fidelity sources for realism or luxury.

imageAssetSchema.conceptId: Normalized subject for comparing the same concept across visual styles
imageAssetSchema.imageUrl: Local path or official linked preview URL
imageAssetSchema.publicImageUrl: Absolute default preview or asset URL
imageAssetSchema.downloadUrl: Production asset, source page, or local asset URL depending on usageMode
imageAssetSchema.usageMode: bundled, grouped variants, linked source, or attribution
imageAssetSchema.variants: Optional named style or weight URLs grouped under one concept
imageAssetSchema.bestFor: Contexts where the asset style is a strong fit
imageAssetSchema.avoidWhen: Contexts where another visual family should be preferred

animatedBackgroundSchema.previewUrl: Original externally hosted MP4 or HLS media URL
animatedBackgroundSchema.downloadUrl: Direct MP4 download or adaptive HLS manifest URL
animatedBackgroundSchema.thumbnailUrl: Local 640x360 WebP extracted from the opening frame
animatedBackgroundSchema.publicThumbnailUrl: Absolute opening-frame thumbnail URL for external consumers
animatedBackgroundSchema.licenceClass: commercial-use based on Lumora owner confirmation

imageSelectionGuidance.primaryRule: Search by concept, then choose the visual family that fits the brand; subject-name overlap is intentional.
imageSelectionGuidance.consistencyRule: Use one primary icon or illustration family per interface and mix styles only for an explicit hierarchy.
imageSelectionGuidance.groupedVariants: Phosphor weights are grouped in one record so Codex can choose a consistent regular, thin, light, bold, fill, or duotone treatment.
imageSelectionGuidance.linkedAssets: ambientCG preview images are not production PBR maps; fetch production maps from the official material page.

componentSelectionGuidance.ownedOriginal: Lumora owned-original recipes are implementation briefs built from first principles.
componentSelectionGuidance.originKit: OriginKit records link to the official current implementation and remote selection previews; source code and media are not mirrored.
componentSelectionGuidance.selectionRule: Choose by page purpose and art direction, then verify dependencies, responsive behavior, accessibility, reduced motion, and performance in the target project.
componentSelectionGuidance.previewEngine: All 85 owned archetypes have representative SVG compositions. Linked cards load a paused official opening frame only near the viewport; only the selected inspector plays motion. Previews guide selection and are not production source or media.
componentSelectionGuidance.reactBits: React Bits records link to its public registry, official live demos, and remote selection previews. React Bits Pro is excluded.
componentSelectionGuidance.canvasUi: Canvas UI records link to official six-framework registry variants and remote selection previews. Preserve documented browser fallbacks.
componentSelectionGuidance.linkedSourceBoundary: React Bits and Canvas UI use MIT + Commons Clause v1.0: commercial end-project use is allowed, but do not sell or redistribute the component libraries themselves.

componentSchema.officialSourceUrl: Official detail page for a linked component
componentSchema.registryUrl: Optional official shadcn-compatible registry payload for the selected component
componentSchema.officialVariants: Available language, styling, or framework variants
componentSchema.previewVideoUrl: Optional official remote selection preview; never production media
